stories.title: Sample: An AI helper explains software errors
stories.source_excerpt: Fictional RSS excerpt: a writing helper explains software error messages in plain language.
stories.simple_explanation: This fictional example describes a tool that explains error messages in plain English. A learner could use the explanation to understand what went wrong, then check the suggested fix themselves. This is sample content for testing the dashboard, not an actual product announcement.
stories.why_it_matters: Clear explanations can help beginners learn debugging. AI suggestions still need to be checked.

stories.title: Sample: A team uses AI to suggest test cases
stories.source_excerpt: Fictional RSS excerpt: a team asks an AI assistant for suggested test cases.
stories.simple_explanation: In this fictional scenario, a team asks an AI assistant to suggest ways a form could fail. Suggestions include blank fields and unexpected input. A human reviews the suggestions before turning them into tests. This sample illustrates the explanation format and is not a real news report.
stories.why_it_matters: Suggested tests may help a team spot cases they missed, but people must decide what the software should do.
